subject: Chemistry
question: Which of the points in the wave function graph (Figure 2) most accurately represents the spherical nodal surface shown in the electron probability density of the 2s orbital (Figure 1)? (see diagram)
explanation: Explanation: A nodal surface is a region in space where the wave function crosses zero, meaning the probability density (psi^2) of finding the electron is exactly zero. Looking at Figure 2 (the wave function graph of the 2s orbital), point B is the exact location where the curve crosses the horizontal distance axis (y = 0). Thus, point B represents the spherical nodal surface.
